verdicts.reason: A: the oversized Meridian logo straddles the top edge of the blue panel, half on the sky and half on the panel, which is a clear collision. The '40% OFF' badge is squashed into a flat, tiny ellipse that floats in the bottom-left. The panel bleeds off the left and bottom edges. Headline, copy and CTA do keep a sensible top-to-bottom order. B: the CTA and the squashed badge are jammed into the top-left corner, above the logo and headline, which breaks the reading order and hierarchy. The logo is so large it competes with the headline. The panel covers almost all of the beach scene, so most of the original imagery is lost, and the sunglasses sit awkwardly on the blue field.
